teaser: A guitar case leans by the door, strap still buckled from the drive over. You are a 5, restless by number, and an ISTP, a hands-first craftsman by type, and this crossing shows up fastest in the half-second before a decision: you have moved before anyone else finished the sentence. The 5 wants motion and width; the ISTP wants a problem it can solve alone, with its hands. You end up leaving early, fixing things nobody asked about, and treating commitment the way a held note gets treated — fine, until it has to keep going.
excerpt: The bag stays half-packed near the door, not from any plan to leave, just from habit.
